what_happened: On a multi-lane freeway with a STRAIGHT command, the policy's planned path (orange) kept bending left out of its lane, away from the recorded path (green). The ego drifted into the left lane and its front hit vehicle 41, which was driving alongside it, about 1.5 m off the recorded trajectory.

On a multi-lane highway with a STRAIGHT command, the policy's planned path bent left, toward the adjacent lane. The ego drifted about 1.3 m left of the recorded trajectory and its front struck actor 41, which was passing on the left and pulling alongside.

After nearly tailgating lead car 1 (5 m gap at handoff) and braking to about 3 m/s, the ego drifted left onto the lane line, away from the planned route (the command was RIGHT). Its front-left corner then clipped actor 33, which was passing in the left lane, at 7.6 s.

The ego braked hard behind lead car 1 (7.9 to 3 m/s). It then stayed slow even after the gap opened to more than 20 m, and drifted about 1.3 m left of the recorded path toward the left lane. Car 33, which was coming up from behind on the left, clipped the ego's rear-left side (lateral contact, with a rear contact also recorded) at 7.1 s.
